corrections.wrong: She has been starting to write her novel three months ago.
corrections.correct: She has been writing her novel for three months.
corrections.rule: PPC never takes 'ago' or 'start'; use for/since.
corrections.rule_tr: Present Perfect Continuous 'ago' ve 'start/begin' almaz; for/since kullan.

corrections.wrong: Judy has been meeting twelve customers.
corrections.correct: Judy has met twelve customers. / Judy has been meeting customers since this morning.
corrections.rule_tr: Sayı varsa sonuç vardır → Present Perfect Simple.

corrections.wrong: Wayne has been playing tennis three games. / He has made two cake.
corrections.correct: Wayne has played three games. / He has made two cakes.
corrections.rule_tr: Aynı kural (sayı → Simple); çoğul isim -s alır.

corrections.wrong: His clothes are dirty because he has played in the mud.
corrections.correct: His clothes are dirty because he has been playing in the mud.
corrections.rule: Visible evidence of an activity → continuous.
corrections.rule_tr: Bir eylemin görünür izi varsa → Continuous.

corrections.wrong: The waiter have forgotten us.
corrections.correct: The waiter has forgotten us.
corrections.rule_tr: Tekil özne (he/she/it) → has.

corrections.wrong: He must realize we have ordered.
corrections.correct: He must realize we haven't ordered yet.
corrections.rule_tr: Parantezdeki ipucunu oku: (order, not) = olumsuz.

corrections.wrong: The poor old lady have been cooking.
corrections.correct: The poor old lady has been cooking.
corrections.rule_tr: Tekil özne → has been.

corrections.wrong: If Kate continued spending, she will run out of money.
corrections.correct: If Kate continues spending, she will run out of money.
corrections.rule_tr: Conditional tiplerini karıştırma: If + present → will.

corrections.wrong: I hope Simon be will there.
corrections.correct: I hope Simon will be there.
corrections.rule_tr: Sıralama: will + be.

corrections.wrong: Will I live in Leeds in a few years?
corrections.correct: Will I be living in Leeds in a few years' time?
corrections.rule_tr: Future Continuous = will + be + V-ing.

corrections.wrong: Let's go out to kill me.
corrections.correct: Let's go out to kill time.
corrections.rule: kill time = waste time while waiting.
corrections.rule_tr: kill time = beklerken vakit öldürmek.

corrections.wrong: profound = waste-water systems; sanitation = deep understanding
corrections.correct: profound = deep (understanding, impact); sanitation = waste-water systems
corrections.rule_tr: Tanımları kontrol et: profound = derin; sanitation = atık su sistemleri.

corrections.wrong: attitude = general opinion; purpose = the way you behave
corrections.correct: reputation = general opinion; attitude = the way you behave
corrections.rule_tr: Tanımları kontrol et: genel görüş = reputation; davranış biçimi = attitude.

corrections.wrong: ...and they would be right.
corrections.correct: ...and they may be right.
corrections.rule_tr: Şimdiki olasılık → may/might.

corrections.wrong: propound, interfure, dramaticly, old fashioned
corrections.correct: profound, interfere, dramatically, old-fashioned
corrections.rule_tr: -ic sıfatlar → -ically; old-fashioned tireli yazılır.

corrections.wrong: We are out of patient, we were wait too long time.
corrections.correct: We're out of patience; we've been waiting too long.
corrections.rule: patient vs patience; no 'too long time'.
corrections.rule_tr: patient = hasta/sabırlı, patience = sabır; 'too long time' denmez.

corrections.wrong: I am create a document for client.
corrections.correct: I am creating a document for a client.
corrections.rule_tr: Tekil sayılabilir isimden önce artikel (a client); am'den sonra V-ing.

corrections.wrong: Let's discuss about the project.
corrections.correct: Let's discuss the project.
corrections.rule_tr: discuss 'about' almaz.

corrections.wrong: When I was 5 years old, I didn't used to wear glasses.
corrections.correct: When I was 5 years old, I didn't use to wear glasses.
corrections.rule_tr: did/didn't'ten sonra 'use to' gelir, -d olmaz.

corrections.wrong: She would have a house in the country.
corrections.correct: She used to have a house in the country.
corrections.rule: would is not used with stative verbs.
corrections.rule_tr: would durum fiilleriyle (have = sahip olmak) kullanılmaz; used to kullan.

corrections.wrong: I'd rather to go to the cinema.
corrections.correct: I'd rather go to the cinema.
corrections.rule_tr: would rather'dan sonra yalın fiil gelir (to yok).

corrections.wrong: I'd prefer eat outside in the garden.
corrections.correct: I'd prefer to eat outside in the garden.
corrections.rule_tr: would prefer'dan sonra to + fiil gelir.

corrections.wrong: I prefer trains than cars.
corrections.correct: I prefer trains to cars.
corrections.rule_tr: prefer ile karşılaştırma 'than' değil 'to' ile yapılır.

corrections.wrong: I'd rather you take a taxi.
corrections.correct: I'd rather you took a taxi.
corrections.rule: would rather + another person + past simple.
corrections.rule_tr: Başkası için tercih: I'd rather you + geçmiş zaman (anlam şimdi/gelecek).

corrections.wrong: I'm knowing the answer.
corrections.correct: I know the answer.
corrections.rule: Stative verbs are not used in continuous forms.
corrections.rule_tr: Durum fiilleri (know, want, own…) -ing almaz.

corrections.wrong: The soup tastes well.
corrections.correct: The soup tastes good.
corrections.rule_tr: Linking verb'den sonra zarf değil sıfat gelir.

corrections.wrong: While I studied, I was suddenly feeling sleepy.
corrections.correct: While I was studying, I suddenly felt sleepy.
corrections.rule: Long action → past continuous; short interrupting action → past simple.
corrections.rule_tr: Uzun süren eylem past continuous, araya giren kısa eylem past simple.

corrections.wrong: I was knowing I wanted to marry him the first time I met him.
corrections.correct: I knew I wanted to marry him the first time I met him.
corrections.rule_tr: know durum fiilidir; geçmişte de continuous olmaz.

corrections.wrong: I suspicioned my uncle about crimed.
corrections.correct: I suspected my uncle of the crime.
corrections.rule: suspicion is a noun; the verb is suspect someone of something.
corrections.rule_tr: suspicion isimdir; fiil hali suspect: suspect someone of + isim.

corrections.wrong: We assumed that pass your exam.
corrections.correct: We assumed that you had passed your exam.
corrections.rule_tr: assume that'ten sonra özne + fiil olan tam bir cümle gelir.

corrections.wrong: The police detectived him.
corrections.correct: The police investigated the case.
corrections.rule: detective is a noun; the verb is investigate.
corrections.rule_tr: detective isimdir; fiil olarak investigate kullanılır.

corrections.wrong: They was looking for some cue.
corrections.correct: They were looking for clues.
corrections.rule_tr: they ile were; ipucu = clue (cue = işaret, replik).

corrections.wrong: The police arrived the home in 10 minutes.
corrections.correct: The police arrived at the house in 10 minutes.
corrections.rule: arrive at / in + place (no direct object).
corrections.rule_tr: arrive nesne almaz: arrive at + bina, arrive in + şehir.

corrections.wrong: The alarm hadn't been switch on.
corrections.correct: The alarm hadn't been switched on.
corrections.rule: Passive past perfect: had been + V3.
corrections.rule_tr: Edilgen past perfect: had been + V3.

corrections.wrong: A neighbour hearded a car at 8:30.
corrections.correct: A neighbour heard a car at 8:30.
corrections.rule_tr: hear düzensizdir: hear – heard – heard.

corrections.wrong: The old man wanted talk the monster.
corrections.correct: The old man wanted to talk to the monster.
corrections.rule: want + to V1; talk to someone.
corrections.rule_tr: want + to + fiil; talk to + kişi.

corrections.wrong: Him uncle was shock when he was looking for car keys.
corrections.correct: His uncle was shocked when he was looking for the car keys.
corrections.rule_tr: İyelik: his; duygu sıfatı -ed: shocked.

corrections.wrong: Professor Tomero, that teaches a Sociology class, was out sick.
corrections.correct: Professor Tomero, who teaches a Sociology class, was out sick.
corrections.rule_tr: Virgüllü ilgi cümlesinde that kullanılmaz; who / which kullan.

Correct it: I have been knowing the client since 2023.
answers: I have known the client since 2023.
